provenance.source: Built with src/argus_mask/editor/build_head.py from scripts/stock_heads/stock-02.json: Blender 4.5.15 LTS, MPFB 2.0.18, asset packs makehuman_system_assets, faceunits01 and suits02
provenance.notes: MakeHuman base mesh and targets (bundled with MPFB 2.0.18); skin young_caucasian_female, hair short02, eyes high-poly (brown), eyebrow002, eyelashes02, teeth_base, tongue01 (makehuman_system_assets pack, CC0); ARKit face units by Mika Suominen (faceunits01 pack, CC0); uniform thegreatengineer_galactic_warrior_uniform by TheGreatEngineer (suits02 pack, CC0). Phenotype: female, age macro 0.5 (about 25 years). A generated character, not a real person. The mouth settings, uniform, wet line and baked skin maps of stock-01 revision 4. Revision 2: skinned to MPFB's game_engine rig (53 bones), so the head turns at the neck and the shoulders stay still. Revision 3: wears shoes03 boots (makehuman_system_assets pack, CC0); skin a garment covers below the neck is removed, so none shows through. Other framings, same revision: waist.glb, the same build cut below the hips, arms and all; full.glb, head to shoes, nothing cut.
